mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 202.5 indicates moderate inflation that supports economic growth without triggering aggressive policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 202.5, or rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
